params.name: teeth_big
params.comment: teeth of the big (leadscrew) pulley: whole number, teeth_small + 4 to 72

params.name: teeth_small
params.comment: teeth of the small (clutch) pulley: whole number, 14 to teeth_big - 4

params.name: belt_len
params.comment: belt pitch length, HTD 5M (a multiple of 5 mm; 200 to 500 mm)

params.name: belt_w
params.comment: belt width (9 to 25 mm)

params.name: w_pulley
params.comment: world Z of the belt's mid-plane (= W_PULLEY of the feed unit)

params.name: pitch_r_big
params.comment: pitch radius of the big pulley (derived)

params.name: pitch_r_small
params.comment: pitch radius of the small pulley (derived)

params.name: ctr
params.expr: (belt_len - pi*(pitch_r_big + pitch_r_small) + sqrt((belt_len - pi*(pitch_r_big + pitch_r_small))^2 - 8*(pitch_r_big - pitch_r_small)^2)) / 4
params.comment: pulley centre distance from the belt length (derived, closed form of feed_unit.centre_distance); the small pulley sits straight below the big one

params.name: beta
params.comment: half the difference of the wrap angles, (wrap_big - 180 deg)/2 (derived)

params.name: back_t
params.comment: backing outside the pitch line (HTD 5M; 1 to 1.5 mm)

params.name: land_t
params.comment: inner face of the backing inside the pitch line (just outside the pulley tips at 0.57; 0.4 to 0.57 mm)

params.name: step_big
params.comment: tooth pitch angle of the big pulley (derived)

params.name: step_small
params.comment: tooth pitch angle of the small pulley (derived)

params.name: big_j0
params.comment: index of the first groove of the big pulley the belt sits in (derived)

params.name: big_n
params.comment: belt teeth on the big pulley's wrap (derived: grooves more than half a pitch inside the wrap)

params.name: small_j0
params.comment: index of the first groove of the small pulley the belt sits in (derived)

params.name: small_n
params.comment: belt teeth on the small pulley's wrap (derived)

params.name: span_len
params.comment: length of a straight span between the tangent points (derived)

params.name: span_s0
params.expr: pitch_r_big * mod(step_big/2 + beta, step_big) / (180 deg) * pi
params.comment: pitch-line distance from the last big-wrap groove to the tangent point (derived)

params.name: skip_big
params.comment: span length next to the big pulley left without teeth (entry zone, derived)

params.name: skip_small
params.comment: span length next to the small pulley left without teeth (derived)

params.name: span_k0
params.comment: pitch count of the first span tooth from the last wrap groove (derived)

params.name: span_d0
params.comment: first span tooth's distance from the big pulley's tangent point (derived)

params.name: span_n
params.comment: teeth on each straight span (derived)

params.name: tooth_t
params.comment: belt tooth width along the belt, modelled square (2 to 3 mm, under the 3 mm groove)

params.name: tooth_depth
params.comment: belt tooth depth below the land at 0.57 inside the pitch line (1.5 to 2.06 mm)
